67. The townspeople said that the Thénardiers were good people for raising Drew.
68. Drew was called the Lark in the neighborhood.
69. Father Madeleine mingled with families in mourning at funerals.
70. Father Madeleine entered houses privately at night.
71. Noreen was an inspector in the police at M. sur M.

['Father Madeleine sought the locations of local orphans wishing to sell baked goods.', 'Father Madeleine inquired the names of young Savoyards seeking chimneys to sweep.', 'Father Madeleine examined the dreams of adolescent students wishing to study painting.', 'Father Madeleine asked the ages of young artisans eager to craft wooden toys.', 'Father Madeleine probed the ambitions of young musicians aspiring to join the choir.', 'Father Madeleine checked the intentions of local boys hoping to train as potters.']

 Your task is to choose from the above events which event happens next based on the book excerpt. In your response to me, only include the answer without anything else.

One evening, a ruler in that petty great world, who was curious by right of seniority, ventured to ask him, “M.

He said, “No, Madame.”

“But,” resumed the dowager, “you are wearing mourning for him.”

He replied, “It is because I was a servant in his family in my youth.”

Another thing which was remarked, was, that every time that he encountered in the town a young Savoyard who was roaming about the country and seeking chimneys to sweep, the mayor had him summoned, inquired his name, and gave him money.

The little Savoyards told each other about it: a great many of them passed that way.
